description: FEMultiPhys: A Finite Element Program for the Analysis of Continua and Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ioannis Koutromanos, Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (vt.edu). This is the Designsafe page for the simulation code FEMultiPhys (Finite Elements for Multiple Physics). It includes executables, installation instructions, user documentation and video tutorials. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-j5mp-a358. Keywords: finite element analysis software - multiple physics - coupled problems. Published 2024-05-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
